top_band: light tan/brown wood top surface from row 1 to row 5 (with back rim at row 0 and front edge highlight at row 5)
evidence: Row 0 is a back edge, rows 1-4 are the horizontal top surface, row 5 is a bright front-edge highlight, rows 6-7 form the front thickness of the top overhang, rows 8-9 are a dark eave shadow beneath it, and rows 10-30 show the vertical front face with inset door panels (dark inner top/left shadows at rows 12-25) and handles.

style.evidence: The wood ramp uses about 6 distinct brown/tan tones and includes bevels, inset door shadows, and subtle grain spots on the top, However, it is framed on left, right, and bottom by a solid 1px pure black (0,0,0) outer border, and the vertical door panels are simple geometric blocks compared to the richer organic pixel work on the Beodeul reference stall.
